info.title: Inventory Control API
info.description: This API aims to provide complete inventory control.

parameters.name: search

parameters.description: ID of the product to be edited.

requestBody.description: Input data required to edit a product.

delete.description: Delete a product. **Accessible to Administrators and Operators.**

post.description: Create product. **Accessible to Administrators and Operators.**

Stock assistant powered by Amazon Bedrock (Converse API with tool use). The model answers in Portuguese and queries products, stock and sales through read-only tools. Needs AWS credentials in .env.aws. **Accessible to Administrators, Operators, and Sellers.**

requestBody.description: Conversation history (up to the last 10 messages, 2000 characters each). The last message must be from the user.

400.description: Invalid messages, missing AWS credentials, Bedrock quotas at 0 or Bedrock error. The body is { error }.

post.description: Suggests the product name, description and category from a product photo, using a Bedrock vision model (default Amazon Nova Lite). Nothing is saved: the front-end fills the form and the user reviews it. **Accessible to Administrators and Operators.**

file.description: JPG, PNG, WEBP or GIF up to 3.75 MB.

hint.description: Optional extra information for the AI (up to 300 characters).

400.description: Missing or unsupported image, missing AWS credentials, Bedrock quotas at 0 or Bedrock error. The body is { error }.

post.description: Sales and stock analysis written by Amazon Bedrock (default Nova Micro) from the numbers already calculated by the restock forecast. **Accessible to Administrators, Operators, and Sellers.**

400.description: Missing AWS credentials, Bedrock quotas at 0 or Bedrock error. The body is { error }.

get.description: Smart product search by meaning (embeddings). The query is turned into a vector with Amazon Titan Text Embeddings V2 and compared with the indexed products (vectors stored in SQLite). Repeated queries are cached in memory. **Accessible to Administrators, Operators, and Sellers.**

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: What the user is looking for (2 to 200 characters).

400.description: Invalid search, empty index, missing AWS credentials, Bedrock quotas at 0 or Bedrock error. The body is { error }.

get.description: How many products are indexed for the smart search. **Accessible to Administrators, Operators, and Sellers.**

post.description: Creates or updates the embeddings of all products. Products whose text did not change are skipped unless force is true. Products are also reindexed automatically when created or edited. **Accessible to Administrators and Operators.**

400.description: Invalid search, empty index, missing AWS credentials, Bedrock quotas at 0 or Bedrock error. The body is { error }.

post.description: Reads a supplier invoice or order (PDF or image) with a Bedrock model that understands documents (default Amazon Nova Lite) and returns the header and the product lines, each one matched to an existing product when the AI is confident. Nothing is saved: the user reviews the lines and then calls POST /v1/stock-entries. **Accessible to Administrators and Operators.**

file.description: PDF, JPG, PNG or WEBP up to 4.5 MB.

400.description: Missing or unsupported file, no products found, missing AWS credentials, Bedrock quotas at 0 or Bedrock error. The body is { error }.

post.description: Adds units to the stock of one or more products in a single transaction and records each entry in the stock entry history. Repeated products are summed. **Accessible to Administrators and Operators.**

400.description: Invalid items or product not found. The body is { error }.

get.description: List the sales history, most recent first. Always paginated (default page 1, limit 10). **Accessible to Administrators, Operators, and Sellers.**

Restock forecast calculated from the sales history (no AI): sales pace per product, days of stock left and units to restock to cover the coverage period. Lists only products out of stock, critical (up to 7 days) or low. **Accessible to Administrators, Operators, and Sellers.**

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Sales period used to measure the pace: 7, 30 (default) or 90.

parameters.name: coverage_days
parameters.description: How many days the stock should last after restocking (7 to 90, default 30).

delete.description: Remove one sale from the history. The product stock is not changed. **Accessible to Administrators and Operators.**

put.description: Sell a product. **Accessible to Administrators, Operators, and Sellers.**

requestBody.description: Input data required to sell a product.

post.description: Sign-in and authenticate user. **No authentication required.**

requestBody.description: Data required for user sign-in and authentication.

user_type_id.description: ID of the user type (e.g., Administrator, Operator, Seller).
ID of the authenticated user's type.

messages.content: Quais produtos estão com estoque baixo?

category_id.description: Existing category chosen by the AI, or null.

new_category_name.description: Suggested new category when none of the existing ones fits.

daysLeft.description: Null when the product had no sales in the period.

product_id.description: Existing product matched by the AI, or null.

reference.description: Invoice number or another reference (up to 100 characters).

product_id.description: Null when the product was removed.

totalRevenue.description: Sum of the totals of the filtered sales.

totalUnits.description: Units sold in the filtered sales.

user_type_id.description: ID of the user type (e.g., Administrator, Operator, Seller).
